  2. Amble – To walk at a slow, relaxed pace (Possible antonym).

  3. Trudge – To walk slowly with heavy steps, often due to exhaustion (Not an antonym).

  4. Ramble – To walk aimlessly without direction (Possible antonym).

Since "march" means to walk in a steady, rhythmic, and purposeful manner, the best antonym is "amble" (B), which means to walk slowly and without urgency.

14969.explanation:
The passage clearly states that:

  • A nuclear exchange would have global consequences.
  • It is very improbable that it would remain limited to industrialised nations.
  • Developments suggest that a nuclear disaster would be carried into developing regions such as Asia, Africa, and Latin America.

This directly supports the idea of a spread of nuclear disaster to developing countries, not just confinement to one region.
